purpose: The narrowest possible allowlist of production files under api/, src/lib/, and supabase/migrations/ that the Impact-Aware CI fail-closed gate (scripts/impact-map.mjs) must NOT require a registry mapping for. This is not a directory exclusion — every entry is one exact file path with an individually-verified, one-line justification. A file only belongs here if it contains zero Carson protected-capability business logic (no decision routing, delegation, WhatsApp send/delivery, automation execution, reminder scheduling, Communication History, push lifecycle, or auth/RLS enforcement) — generic app-shell, third-party integration passthrough, or UI-only plumbing. When in doubt, a file is NOT excluded and must fail closed until the registry is updated truthfully.

excluded_files.justification: Weather widget backend (Open-Meteo passthrough). Produces a Carson-ready spoken sentence as a data source, but contains no decision routing, delegation, WhatsApp, automation, reminder, Communication History, push, or auth logic of its own.

Generic passthrough proxy to the Anthropic API (forwards the request body, checks for an API key, returns the response). No Carson-specific business logic — used as raw infrastructure by higher-level modules that ARE registered.
Generic passthrough proxy to OpenAI Whisper transcription (streams the multipart body through unchanged). No Carson-specific business logic.
Supabase client singleton initialization only (reads env vars, constructs the client). No business logic.
Service worker registration boilerplate (navigator.serviceWorker.register). No Carson business logic.
Detects whether the app is running as an installed standalone PWA, for iOS push-support messaging. Platform-detection utility, not a Carson decision/communication/automation contract.
Pure DOM-free UI logic for the Updates chip row's idle auto-scroll marquee. Presentational only.

Client-side Supabase Auth session state machine (sign-in/sign-out/session-restore). This is NOT the auth_rls capability, which is about server-side Postgres row-level-security policy enforcement — this file has no RLS policy logic, it only tracks the browser's current auth session.
Public sign-in/sign-up/sign-out action wrappers around the Supabase Auth SDK, with error-message normalization. Same distinction as session.ts — no RLS policy logic.

Generic Supabase Storage image resize/upload helper used by multiple unrelated features (task images, proof photos). No decision, delegation, or delivery logic of its own — it is a storage utility other registered modules call into.
Account-level 'delete all my tasks and messages' data-management utility. Not part of any Carson decision/communication/automation/delivery contract.
Sets archived_at on completed tasks/messages so they leave active views. UI/data-lifecycle housekeeping, not a Carson decision or communication contract.

Builds delegation message text for the owner to manually copy to clipboard as a fallback UI action — not the system's actual WhatsApp delegation send path (that is src/lib/delegations.ts, already registered under staff_delegation).
UI-only confirmation-banner dismissal state persisted on the task row. Presentational, not a decision/communication/automation contract.
